title: Review notes anchored to line numbers, not content; line changes leave notes stale but visible
context: Code-review hosts re-anchor comments to keep them through many pushes. These notes are meant for one review cycle within a minute of reading the diff.
decision: Record line range only, no text snippet. Edit the file and the anchor is stale; note still lists and sends against its original line.
consequences: Fails gracefully instead of silently: if agent rewrites while notes are open, reader can tell because note carries its own prose. Simpler mechanism for short-lived notes.
